name: B10-0485/2026 (S&D) – Escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns drone attacks on civilian ships in the Black Sea near Bulgaria and Romania, which sank vessels and left seafarers dead or missing. It does not change any law. It calls for EU support for search and rescue, sanctions on those responsible once investigations establish blame, a new Black Sea maritime security hub, more air and sea defences, and protection for seafarers. It also urges more military support for Ukraine.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament asks the EU to act on sanctions, defence and a Black Sea security hub.
- **Who it affects:** Seafarers, Bulgaria and Romania, shipping and food trade, and Ukraine.
- **What happens next:** EU governments and the Commission decide whether to act; investigations into the attacks continue.
